rationale: Retain 14 prior roles and replace sme_fp32_tiles with register_reuse. The prior tile-store proposal duplicated the baseline; loaded-vector reuse provides a different review focus within four ZA.S tiles. Transpose and packing roles cover conversion and consumer layouts. Blocking, loop-order, vector-access and cache-layout roles cover traversal and memory access. Scratch and streaming roles cover timed setup and cleanup. Fast-path and tail roles preserve dispatch, bounds and general-size correctness. Compiler and assembly roles check concrete source changes, operand mappings and duplicate proposals using supplied evidence only; unavailable compiler output remains unverified. The measured TB wrapper failed adoption, so its aliases must be excluded. TA and TT remain unmeasured options, without a speed ranking. The 320-byte padding attempt timed out and has no measured result. This roster selects advisors only, not experiments or a queue. Advisors must jointly rank distinct legal proposals. All advice remains unverified; preserve ten candidate reports, ten fresh alternating paired controls, best-of-three timing, the fixed 5% gate, held-out validation and both comparator reports.
